label: EU-political-ads-2024 Article 17

obligations.text: At the request of interested entities, providers of political advertising services shall transmit promptly and free of charge, and where technically possible in a machine-readable format, to those entities the information that those providers of political advertising services are required to have pursuant to Articles 9, 11 and 12.
Interested entities requesting the transmission of information pursuant to paragraph 1 shall be independent from commercial interests and shall fall in one or more of the following categories:

Following a request from an interested entity, the provider of political advertising services shall make best efforts to provide the requested information or a reasoned response under paragraph 5 as soon as possible and, at the latest, within one month.

In such cases, the provider of political advertising services shall send a reasoned response to the interested entity making the request along with information on the possibilities for redress, including, where applicable, those that exist under Directive (EU) 2020/1828.

Where the processing of the requests pursuant to paragraph 1 entails significant costs, the provider of political advertising services may charge a reasonable and proportionate fee, which in any event shall not exceed the administrative costs of providing the information requested.

Providers of political advertising services shall bear the burden of demonstrating that a request is manifestly unclear, excessive or concerns information not in their possession, or that requests entail significant processing costs.
